author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Ham in 3/4 view: rounded body with a curved cut edge separating the cut face from the skin, and the bone knob protruding at the bottom right (three quarters of an r4 circle, its inner quarter hidden), as in the reference. No Lucide match; cubic construction.
omissions: The bone cross-section ellipse on the cut face is omitted: at 8-unit spacing it can only be a dot, and a dot there reads as an eye (fish head).
